H8519.derivation: or תּלֻנָּה; from H3885 (לוּן) in the sense of obstinacy;

H8520.derivation: probably from an unused root meaning to dissever; breach;

H8525.derivation: from an unused root meaning to accumulate;

H8528.derivation: from H8510 (תֵּל) and H4417 (מֶלַח); mound of salt;

H8530.derivation: feminine from an unused root meaning to tower;

H8535.def: complete; usually (morally) pious; specifically, gentle, dear

H8539.kjv: be amazed, be astonished, marvel(-lously), wonder.

H8543.derivation: or תְּמֹל; probably for H865 (אֶתְמוֹל); sometimes with H8032 (שִׁלְשׁוֹם)

H8548.derivation: from an unused root meaning to stretch;
H8548.def: properly, continuance (as indefinite extension); but used only (attributively as adjective) constant (or adverbially, constantly); ellipt. the regular (daily) sacrifice

H8549.def: entire (literally, figuratively or morally); also (as noun) integrity, truth
H8549.kjv: without blemish, complete, full, perfect, sincerely (-ity), sound, without spot, undefiled, upright(-ly), whole.

H8551.def: to sustain; by implication, to obtain, keep fast; figuratively, to help, follow close

H8552.def: to complete, in a good or a bad sense, literal, or figurative, transitive or intransitive

H8558.derivation: from an unused root meaning to be erect;

H8562.derivation: or תַּמְרֻק; or תַּמְרִיק; from H4838 (מָרַק);

H8565.derivation: from an unused root probably meaning to elongate;
H8565.def: a monster (as preternaturally formed), i.e. a sea-serpent (or other huge marine animal); also a jackal (or other hideous land animal)

H8588.derivation: or תַּעֲנֻג; and (feminine) תַּעֲנֻגָה; from H6026 (עָנַג);

H8597.def: ornament (abstractly or concretely, literally or figuratively)
